title: Kylian Mbappe sorry for apparent reference to Mao as 'dictator'

blocks.text: BEIJING — Football star Kylian Mbappe apologized for comments in which he apparently referred to Mao Zedong, the founding leader of Communist China, as a dictator, after facing backlash and losing brand deals with at least three different Chinese companies. “My comment was ill-judged, and I now understand that it hurt many people in China and in Chinese communities around the world,” Mbappe said in a statement Tuesday. “I apologize to everyone my words have upset,” he said. “This was absolutely not my intention. I have deep respect for the Chinese people and their history, and I am sincerely sorry.” READ: […]... Keep on reading: Kylian Mbappe sorry for apparent reference to Mao as 'dictator'
